description: Bulk-add players to a tournament's roster (organizer step 2, right after create_tournament; needs that tournament's manage_code). Each player needs a name; email and phone are optional per player, but entries whose email duplicates an existing roster email are skipped. This roster is what generate_bracket seeds from. Returns how many were imported and which rows were skipped, and why.

players.description: Player objects to add: {name (required), email?, phone?}. Max 500 per call
